post.description: Reading one Megekko product after search, or from a pasted megekko.nl/product/ URL.

product_id.description: Megekko article number, e.g. 293095 (the product_id from search). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,10}$.

url.description: megekko.nl product URL, e.g. https://www.megekko.nl/product/5093/293095/SSD-M-2/Samsung-990-PRO-1TB-M-2-SSD. Supply this or product_id. Pattern: ^https?://(?:www\.)?megekko\.nl/product/(?:[0-9]+/)?[0-9]+(?:[/?#]|$).

200.description:
Megekko product details by article number or product URL: name, brand, manufacturer part number, EAN, EUR price and reference price, schema.org availability, stock and delivery text, category path, images, the full specification table and the customer review score.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `availability` | string | schema.org availability of the offer, e.g. InStock, OutOfStock. |
| `brand` | string |  |
| `category_path` | string[] |  |
| `country` | string | Market of the storefront: always NL. |
| `currency` | string | Currency of every price: EUR. |
| `delivery_text` | string | Delivery part of the stock line, e.g. '1 werkdag (maandag)' or 'uitverkocht'. |
| `description` | string | Short Dutch product description. |
| `ean` | string | EAN / GTIN-13. |
| `for_sale` | boolean | False when the price widget says the article is no longer for sale ('niet (meer) te koop'); the last price is still reported. |
| `images` | string[] |  |
| `in_stock` | boolean |  |
| `language` | string | Storefront language: always nl (labels and texts are Dutch). |
| `manufacturer_part_number` | string | Manufacturer part number (schema.org mpn, 'Vendorcode' in the specs). Megekko truncates long codes to 30 characters. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the source answered. |
| `price` | object |  |
| `product_id` | string | Megekko article number. |
| `rating` | object | Customer reviews Megekko shows for the product (they can include reviews written for sibling variants of the same product family). Null when the product has no reviews. Megekko publishes no aggregate score, so average is computed over the reviews rendered on the product page. |
| `reference_price` | number | 'Meest getoonde prijs laatste 90 dagen' in EUR when shown; null otherwise. |
| `specs` | object[] | Full specification table ('Specificaties'), in page order. |
| `stock_text` | string | Stock and delivery line as shown, e.g. 'Uit eigen voorraad leverbaar. Levertijd: 1 werkdag (maandag)'. |
| `url` | string | Canonical product page. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.description: De Samsung 990 PRO 1TB M.2 SSD is een krachtige en snelle SSD die gebruik maakt van NVMe PCIe 4.0 technologie. Met een maximale leessnelheid van 7450 MB/s en schrijfsnelheid van 6900 MB/s, biedt deze SSD een uitstekende prestatie voor zowel gaming als professioneel gebruik. De DRAM cache en compatibiliteit met de PS5 maken de 990 PRO tot een aantrekkelijke keuze voor gebruikers die op zoek zijn naar een betrouwbare en toonaangevende solid-state drive.

post.description: Finding Megekko products and prices from a Dutch or English keyword, model name or part number, e.g. 'rtx 5070', 'samsung 990 pro', 'MZ-V9P1T0BW'.

page.description:
Result page (default 1); pass the previous next_page. Each further page costs one more upstream request, so pages stop at 10.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 10.

200.description:
Keyword search over the Megekko catalogue, one page at a time, as the storefront's own search box runs it: product name, article number, EUR price, reference price, stock and delivery text, promotion label and category path. Megekko shows no product rating in its results; use product for review scores.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number | Products on this page. Megekko chooses the page size (25, 50 or 100 observed). |
| `country` | string | Market of the storefront: always NL. |
| `currency` | string | Currency of every price: EUR. |
| `has_more` | boolean | Megekko offers a further page. |
| `language` | string | Storefront language: always nl (labels and texts are Dutch). |
| `next_page` | number | Pass as page for the next page; null when exhausted or when page 10 was reached. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the source answered. |
| `page` | number |  |
| `query` | string |  |
| `results` | object[] |  |
| `total_results` | number | Total matches Megekko reports for the query (its search is broad; later results are weaker matches). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
